decisions.briefing: Markets were roughly flat today (NASDAQ +0.5%, S&P 500 +0.3%) — a neutral, low-conviction session. With only $189.29 in cash, well below the $500 deployment threshold, and no strong risk-on signal to justify stretching capital, we held all 7 existing positions and made no new trades.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted modestly higher today, with the NASDAQ up 0.5% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Trading stayed range-bound without the kind of volume or momentum surge that typically signals a decisive shift in sentiment. Absent major news flow, the market essentially treaded water.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢溫和上揚，納斯達克指數上升0.5%，標普500指數上升0.3%，市場缺乏明確方向性的催化因素。成交量與動能未見明顯放大，未出現足以左右市場情緒的重大信號。在缺乏重磅消息的情況下，大盤基本呈現橫盤整理格局。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: "Dry powder" refers to cash kept on the sidelines, ready to deploy when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. On a neutral day with cash below our buying threshold, it's better to hold that reserve than to force a trade just to feel active — patience preserves capital for higher-conviction setups.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指的是暫時持有、等待良機出手的現金儲備。在市場方向不明且現金低於買入門檻的日子裡，寧可耐心持有現金，也不要為了「有動作」而勉強交易——耐性能為日後更具信心的投資機會保留實力。
